name: Web Bluetooth (GATT)
plain: Lets a site connect to a nearby Bluetooth LE device the person picks.
meaning: Reads sensors (heart rate, battery, thermometers) and controls BLE gadgets. Reveals device names and service data; used for fitness, IoT setup and beacons.

access.prompt_ui: Chooser showing nearby BLE devices that match filters, with Pair button
access.persistence: Per session by default; per device with getDevices() behind a flag or recent Chrome
steps: Read, write or subscribe to characteristics

chrome.note: Linux support is not enabled by default.

edge.note: Linux support is not enabled by default.

limits.headline: Can connect to one nearby Bluetooth device you pick from a list
limits.user_action: You tap Connect device and choose a gadget in the list, then press Pair.
can: Show nearby Bluetooth LE devices that match what the site looks for
Connect to the one you pick
Get data from and send commands to that device, such as a heart monitor
cannot: See devices you did not pick or other devices nearby
Connect without you picking from the list
Work in Firefox, Safari, or on iPhone
Work with old Bluetooth devices, since it uses only Bluetooth LE
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge support it, with some limits. Safari and iPhone do not.

story.what_it_is: A site asks to connect to a nearby Bluetooth gadget that you choose.

marketing.name: Web Bluetooth
marketing.pitch: Chrome's docs say the API lets a page talk to nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices, with a picker.

story.for_you: A picker shows nearby devices. You choose one, and the page can talk to just that one, like a heart rate band or a fitness gadget.
story.for_makers: Makers can set up and control gadgets from a web page, with no app to install. The page only sees the one device you pick.

use_cases.example: A web page reads your heart rate band during a workout.
A web page sets up a smart bulb or sensor over Bluetooth.
A browser game uses a Bluetooth controller or a toy robot.
A coding class controls a micro:bit board from the browser.
A glucose or blood pressure monitor sends readings to a web dashboard.
A bad site could tempt you to pick a device and then read its data.

technical_bounds: Cannot scan silently: requestLEScan is behind a flag and not shipped
Block list excludes security sensitive GATT services and characteristics
Only filtered device types unless acceptAllDevices
No Firefox, no Safari, no iOS browsers
Needs HTTPS and a user gesture

history.change: Web Bluetooth ships on Chrome Android
Desktop Chrome on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS
getDevices() and watchAdvertisements behind flag; still experimental in 2026
